description:
Copy on Windows. Paste on Android. Send documents as files.

Clipboard Bridge connects your Windows PC and Android phone without creating an app account or configuring a Firebase project. Discover your computer on the same local network, compare the codes and approve pairing.

- Copy text or one image on Windows for automatic clipboard sending, or use Ctrl+Alt+V and the tray menu.
- On Android, share one image through Copy to PC for the Windows clipboard; shared plain text waits for a Send tap. File sharing and Open with use Send to computer.
- Use Android Open with > Send to computer to save the selected document on your PC, including single images and text files.
- Send multiple photos, videos and files through Android Share or the system file picker. Windows supports its native Share panel and tray file picker.
- See transfer progress, cancel a transfer and choose your Windows receiving folder. Files retain their original bytes and are not opened automatically.
- Pause automatic clipboard sending from the Windows tray, or pause Android sending and receiving without losing pairing.
- File transfers use PC-issued, PC-timed sessions and do not need matching phone and computer clocks.
- Home provides clipboard and file sending, pause, received files and the phone-app download. Settings contains pairing and your receiving folder. The version appears at the bottom. Minimize the window to the tray; closing it exits the tray app.
- Android received-file notifications offer Open file and Show location, including one image saved as a file. Notifications for other transfers stay available.
- Nine locales follow the system language, with English fallback.

The matching Android companion is required: download it from Google Play or the public GitHub Releases page. Both endpoints should be updated to 0.2.3 for the new file sessions. Windows 11 or later, x64, is required.

Android needs Google Play services and access to Google's network. Regions or networks without Google access are currently unsupported. The Android app does not need a permanent foreground service while idle; active file transfers show temporary progress work. The computer must be running and directly reachable.

Clipboard mode supports text or one image up to 16 MiB. File mode supports 1-1,000 files per batch, subject to storage and network limits; folders are not supported. Transfers use authenticated encryption between approved devices. Google can process push metadata. No ads or analytics.

Free and open source: https://github.com/c01-in/clipboard-bridge
Privacy: https://github.com/c01-in/clipboard-bridge/blob/main/PRIVACY.md
releaseNotes: Version 0.2.3 adds separate Home and Settings tabs on Windows, with clipboard sending, file sending, pause and received files available from Home. The Android companion has shorter Copy to PC labels, Open file and Show location actions, and independent transfer notifications. File sharing keeps its existing behavior, including saving a single image as a file. Existing pairing is preserved.
